input_messages.content: Hi! I have a couple of things I’d like help with. First, could you please tell me the total balance I have on my gift cards and also the total balance on my certificates? And then I’d like to make a change to my recent reservation.
Sure, my user ID is mohamed_silva_9265.

Yes, K1NW8N is the reservation I want to change. I’d like to switch it to the cheapest business class round trip available, but I want to keep the same travel dates. I don’t mind if it’s a direct flight or has stopovers—whichever is the lowest price in business class. Could you let me know what my options are?

Thanks for breaking down the options! Yes, I’d like to proceed with changing the reservation for all three passengers to the cheapest business class itinerary you listed, keeping the same dates.

Before we finalize, could you let me know how much my master card would be charged if I use all my certificates first, then all my gift cards, and pay the rest with my master card? I want to minimize the amount charged to my card.

Thanks for the breakdown. Before I confirm, could you also tell me how much my master card would be charged if, instead of changing, I cancel my current reservation and book a new one with the same business class itinerary, using the same payment order (certificates first, then gift cards, then master card)? I want to make sure I’m choosing the option that minimizes my master card payment.
The reason would be a change of plans. Please go ahead and calculate how much would go on my master card if I cancel and rebook, using all certificates and gift cards first.

Yes, please proceed with canceling my current reservation and booking the new business class itinerary. I’d like to use all my certificates first, then all my gift cards, and pay the rest with my master card. Please let me know once it’s done and confirm the final amount that will be charged to my master card.

I have an idea! Since I have three certificates, could we book three separate reservations—one for each passenger—so I can use a different certificate for each? That way, I can maximize the use of my certificates. For my own ticket, I’d like to use the $500 certificate and all my gift cards, and for the other two passengers, use one certificate each. Any remaining balance for each ticket can go on my master card. Could you let me know how much would be charged to my master card in this case?

Thank you for the breakdown. Yes, please proceed with booking three separate reservations as described, using the certificates and gift cards in that order for each ticket, and charging the remaining amounts to my master card. Please confirm once it’s done and let me know the final amount that will be charged to my master card.
Thank you for confirming and for your help! That answers all my questions. I appreciate your assistance. ###STOP###
